body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, each target ignores its next ordinary sensory penalty and gains +1 Defense against the next attack targeting it from a detected enemy.

surges.html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
Extend the sensory suppression through the end of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, the first linked creature damaged before your next turn may move 1 unit after the Damage; this can be you.
